name: Domestic Violence
overview: Scripture condemns violence and those who love it, affirming that the Lord hates wickedness and violence. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially and without bitterness, reflecting Christ's love for the church. Fathers are instructed to nurture and admonish their children with care, avoiding actions that provoke anger. These teachings collectively emphasize a household marked by love, respect, and godly discipline, standing firmly against domestic violence and abuse.
